subject: Thermionics vendor onboarding — consolidated invoicing & PO requirements
messages:
From: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@thermionics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, net terms, consolidated invoices

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week — Thermionics is ready to move forward with a 12‑month commitment contingent on procurement / AP alignment. A few items we need to lock down before we issue a blanket PO: 

- Requirement: PO number must appear on every invoice and be mapped to our ERP (we use Coupa).
- Net terms: prefer net60, but we can consider net45 if needed.
- Invoice cadence: Thermionics prefers one consolidated invoice per month (single monthly statement) vs multiple invoices per project.
- Discounting: we're asking for a 7% price concession if total committed spend >= $250k annually and invoices are consolidated monthly.
- Vendor onboarding docs: W‑9 and tax id, vendor contact for 1099 / remittance, and our procurement form (attached).

Can you confirm Redwood's standard PO fields and whether Redwood supports consolidated monthly billing with a single invoice per month? Also please confirm the discount process — is a spending‑based concession allowed, and what level of approvals are needed?

I attached Thermionics' procurement form for your AP team to complete. If you can get me initial confirmation today, we can draft the blanket PO next week.

Thanks,
Sarah Ellis
Sr. Procurement Manager | Thermionics Labs
procurement@thermionics.com
Attachment: Thermionics_Procurement_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@thermionics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, net terms, consolidated invoices

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list and for the form. Quick answers up front then a couple of asks: 

- PO fields: yes — PO number, remit address, Redwood vendor ID, Redwood tax id (EIN), and a BU/cost center field are required for our ERP to automatically match invoices. Please include the PO number in the Invoice# and in the Invoice header.
- Net terms: Redwood offers net30 by default, net45 on request, and net60 is possible for named enterprise deals with finance approval. Net60 will generally require a signed blanket PO and a credit review.
- Invoice cadence: we can support consolidated monthly statements (single invoice per month) provided the PO references the blanket agreement and line items are aggregated per month.
- Discounting: we can offer two typical paths:
    * 5% discount for an annual prepay or a confirmed committed spend with monthly invoicing (standard commercial approval).
    * Deeper concessions (e.g., 7%) require Finance + Revenue Ops approval and are evaluated against ARR, payment history, and legal signoff.

I attached our vendor W‑9 and a simple invoice template to illustrate the PO placement. Next steps I recommend:
1) Thermionics returns the completed procurement form (you attached).
2) Redwood issues a preliminary invoice template with the vendor ID and PO prefix to validate your ERP mapping.
3) Vivek will help run the net60 concession through Finance if you confirm commitment size and cadence.

If you'd like, I can loop in Ben Carter from Billing to confirm how credit memos / early‑pay credits are handled.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@thermionics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, net terms, consolidated invoices

Hi Sarah — Vivek from Finance here. A few operational notes from our side: 

- Net60: Finance can approve net60 for THERM‑class deals if we have a blanket PO and Thermionics is able to provide standard vendor onboarding (W‑9 + banking details) and agree to a PO verification step each quarter.
- Invoice matching: to avoid exceptions in our ERP, please have the PO number placed in the invoice header and the line item memo with the month period (e.g., "June 2026 usage").
- Consolidated billing: we can do one monthly invoice. That invoice must include cost center mapping for each line so your AP can route charges to the correct internal owner.
- Vendor portal: once the PO is issued, please use our portal to upload the PO and confirm vendor remittance: https://app.redwood-inference.com/vendor-onboard/Thermionics (link below).

Ben — can you confirm typical turnaround for credit memos/early pay? Sarah — if you can provide committed spend numbers (anticipated monthly run‑rate), I'll start the net60 review with Revenue Ops.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@thermionics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, net terms, consolidated invoices

Camila / Vivek — thanks for the quick replies. A few follow ups and our counterproposal: 

- Thermionics confirms estimated annual spend of ~$300k (approx $25k monthly). We will issue a blanket PO with PO prefix "T-LABS-" and expect a single consolidated invoice per month.
- We are asking for a 7% committed‑spend discount (applied to subscription list price) if Redwood confirms consolidated monthly invoicing + net60. This is a firm procurement ask from our AP team.
- We also need a written escalation path for credit memos (if Redwood issues a credit because of usage correction or quality remediation) — typical SLA 30 days to resolve.
- Attached is our filled procurement form and vendor setup checklist.

If Finance requires additional documentation for net60 approval, tell us what is needed and we'll get it started. We can also move forward with the blanket PO signature once discount and remittance routing are confirmed.

Best,
Sarah Ellis
Sr. Procurement Manager, Thermionics Labs
Attachment: Thermionics_Procurement_Form_Filled.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@thermionics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 15:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — PO fields, net terms, consolidated invoices

Hi Sarah — appreciate the fast follow. Summary and next steps: 

- Consolidated monthly invoice + PO prefix "T-LABS-": confirmed. Please include PO number and month period as discussed.
- Net60: Finance has kicked off the credit review. Given the ~$300k ARR and completed vendor forms, net60 is likely approved; Vivek will confirm by early next week.
- Discount: standard approval path — we can guarantee a 5% committed‑spend discount immediately (commercial approval). We will escalate the 7% ask to Revenue Ops + Finance; I expect a decision within 5 business days. If approved, we will issue an amendment to the SOW reflecting the concession.
- Credit memos / escalations: Ben (Billing) confirms a 30‑day SLA for initial investigation and aim to settle credits within 45 days; we will add the escalation path to the invoicing appendix.

Next actions for Thermionics: 
1) Issue the blanket PO with "T-LABS-" prefix and upload to our vendor portal.
2) Email accounting@redwood-inference.com to route remittance details.
3) Once the PO is in the portal, Vivek will confirm net60 and I will follow up on the 7% escalation.

I'll attach the invoice template prefilled with Redwood vendor ID after this thread. Thanks again — excited to get Thermionics onboarded.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Template_Prefill.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
